calls.title: Demo Call with Lacy Brown from Level
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted GrowthBook’s features, including flexible solutions for feature flagging and A/B testing, currently serving over 3,200 companies. It emphasized the platform’s architecture capable of handling billions of flag evaluations daily, key clients like Anthropic and Dropbox, and the user-friendly visual editor facilitating non-technical users. Additionally, the meeting covered the comprehensive experiment setup process, which includes hypothesis definition and traffic allocation, along with the integration of data sources like GA4. The conversation also touched on Level's new customer context, their plans for mixed deployment modes, and the upcoming changes in GrowthBook's pricing model, shifting to usage-based fees, which will affect Level’s cost structure.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, Feature flags, Visual editor, Shopify integration, Experiment metrics, Pricing model
calls.action_items:
